source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design: Hindu Religious Education, Grade 8
source.notes: Filename confirmed against KICD's own Google Drive listing (kicd.ac.ke/cbc-materials/curriculum-designs/grade-eight-designs/, file id 17tep-A_DwMx7ZHQ_JTtCm6wH6HLISdIW, whose /preview page title reads 'HRE Grade 8 - July 2024 - Fin.pdf'). WebFetch reported it could not extract meaningful text from the PDF itself but saved it locally; Read then parsed the full PDF text natively (ISBN 978-9914-43-800-0, First Published 2023, Revised 2024). Strand/sub-strand headings, SLOs, and key inquiry questions below are transcribed verbatim from the 'STRAND'-labelled tables and the 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB-STRANDS' table. NOTABLE STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE FROM GRADE 9: unlike Grade 9 HRE (where every detailed sub-strand was Sikh-specific despite the subject nominally covering four faith traditions), Grade 8's design explicitly rotates across multiple faiths within each strand - e.g. Strand 1 (Enlightened Beings) covers one figure each from Sanatan/Vedic (Chaitanya Mahaprabhu), Jain (Tirthankar Mallinath), Buddhist (Lord Buddha) and Sikh (Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji) traditions in a single sub-strand; Strand 3 (Principles of Dharma) has one sub-strand mixing Sanatan/Jain/Sikh principles and a second sub-strand specifically on Buddhist Principles; Strand 4 (Religious Practices) splits into Sanatan Dharma protocols and Jain Dharma protocols; Strand 6 (Sanskaars) splits into Jain religious ceremonies and Buddhist Sanskaars. This confirms the four-faith rotation happens at a finer grain (within-strand) at Grade 8 rather than being one faith per whole grade as it was at Grade 9.

subStrands.name: Enlightened Beings
subStrands.notes: Covers Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (Sanatan/Vedic), Tirthankar Mallinath (Jain), Lord Buddha, and Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji (Hind Kee Chaadhar) (Sikh) - one figure per faith tradition, unlike Grade 9 where this strand was Sikh-only.
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain key attributes of the selected Enlightened Beings for familiarisation
Outline the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for inspiration in daily life
Participate in activities that reflect the teachings of the Enlightened Beings for individual transformation
Recognize the contributions of Enlightened Beings for guidance in life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to learn the attributes of Enlightened Beings?
How can we implement the teachings of Enlightened Beings in our lives?

subStrands.name: Scriptural Texts
subStrands.notes: Covers Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra, Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19-21 (Summary), Mangala Sutta SN2.4, and Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi (Summary) - one text per faith tradition (Sanatan/Vedic, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh).
specificLearningOutcomes: Analyse the role of scriptures for guidance in daily life
Prepare a code of conduct based on scriptures for personal development
Utilise common teachings from the scriptures for peace and harmony
Appreciate scriptural teachings for spiritual nourishment
keyInquiryQuestions: How does reading of scriptures influence our daily life?
How does code of conduct in scriptures instil moral values?

subStrands.name: Fundamental Principles
subStrands.notes: Covers Sanatan/Vedic - Punarjanam (Reincarnation), Jain - Non-attachment (Aparigraha) and Celibacy (Bhramacharya), Sikh - Satisfaction (Santokh) and Truth (Sat). Five principles across three faith traditions in one sub-strand.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the five selected fundamental Principles of Dharma for character formation
Dramatize the Principles of Dharma in a school environment
Nurture the Principles of Dharma for virtuous living
keyInquiryQuestions: How can Principles of Dharma be practised in day-to-day life?
Why is it important to live by the Principles of Dharma?

subStrands.name: Buddhist Principles of Dharma
subStrands.notes: Covers the Noble Eightfold Path specifically.
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the Buddhist Principles of Dharma for spiritual nourishment
Interpret the Buddhist Principles of Dharma for character formation
Explain the causes of road crashes ignoring noble eightfold path in Buddhist Principles
Acknowledge the Buddhist Principles of Dharma for virtuous living
keyInquiryQuestions: What is the significance of noble eightfold path in our life?

subStrands.name: Protocols in Sanatan Dharma
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the protocols of religious practices observed in a Sanatan/Hindu Mandir
Model the mandatory religious etiquette for self-efficacy
Embrace the protocols and etiquette for personal welfare
keyInquiryQuestions: Why are protocols important in religious practices?

subStrands.name: Protocols in Jain Dharma
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the protocols observed in a Jain Derasar for recognition
Model the mandatory religious etiquette for self-esteem
Acknowledge the protocols and etiquette for social harmony
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to learn about the Aarti, Mangal Divo and its significance?

subStrands.name: Path of Action (Karma Yoga)
subStrands.notes: Covers practitioners Sister Nivedita, Rishabh dev, Buddhaghosha, Bibi Sundari Ji - one prominent practitioner per faith tradition.
specificLearningOutcomes: Examine actions that enable him to understand Karma Yoga
Summarise key events of the selected prominent practitioners of Karma Yoga for social welfare
Implement Karma Yoga for self-improvement
Recognise the essence of Karma Yoga for better understanding
keyInquiryQuestions: How do the lives of practitioners of karma Yoga inspire us?
Why do we need to practise Karma Yoga?
How do different scriptures guide us on Karma Yoga?

subStrands.name: Religious Ceremonies (Jains)
subStrands.notes: Covers Naam (naming), Vivah (marriage), Antim (death) - Jain rite-of-passage ceremonies.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify religious ceremonies observed by Jain faith for knowledge
Interpret the significance of religious ceremonies in Jain faith for self-efficacy
Model all necessary protocols while participating in the religious ceremonies
Embrace the religious ceremonies of one's faith for spiritual nourishment
keyInquiryQuestions: How do religious ceremonies influence one's life?
What role does religious ceremonies play in society?

subStrands.name: Buddhist Sanskaars
subStrands.notes: Covers Naming, Marriage, Death (Maranam) - Buddhist rite-of-passage ceremonies.
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain Buddhist Sanskaars for familiarity
Interpret the significance of Buddhists' Sanskaars for self-confidence
Desire to advocate the Buddhists' Sanskaars for sensitisation
keyInquiryQuestions: How do Sanskaars influence our lives?
